name: v2src-routedeep
desc: ROUTING, DEEPENED. Push the four non-maximal raised findings toward the 1.00 ceiling the author already chose for Lateral Meniscus: ACL 0.75 -> 0.875, Medial Meniscus 0.80 -> 0.90, Lateral OA 0.75 -> 0.875, Fracture 0.75 -> 0.875 (Lateral Meniscus stays 1.00). Extrapolates along the only direction with a measured positive gradient (HANDOFF 67.3).
